label: D2 after a rare transition a2 -> S1
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S1, i.e. a rare a2 -> S1 transition. All inputs here are observed at D2 (the in_action=2, in_state=1 input combination gives the same score). Recall is ~1.0 and mass recall ~1.0, with essentially no activation anywhere else: none at D1 or GO, none on a1 -> S1 (common), none on any S2 arrival. Precision is only ~0.58, though: about 42% of a2 -> S1 D2 steps stay silent. Conditions I tested do not separate active from silent cases well. Requiring the previous trial to be a2 -> S2 common raises precision to 0.70 but drops recall to 0.70. good == 2, prev_action == 2, value thresholds and policy-logit thresholds all lower F1. So whether it turns on and how strongly is set by some graded history-dependent context that I did not capture. It is a detector for the a2-rare-to-S1 event.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over this trial (D2: a2 S1) and last trial (D2: a2 S2 u, a2 S2 r, a1 S2 r); timing cues that raise it most: rel=-3, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0, phase=D2 & ep_dec=8.
